stories.title: Emirados abrem investigação sobre incidente no voo da Flydubai para Israel

en.title: UAE opens investigation into Flydubai flight incident to Israel
en.summary: The United Arab Emirates' attorney general announced an investigation into an incident that occurred aboard a Flydubai flight traveling to Israel, according to state media.

stories.title: Assista ao Bom Dia Amapá desta quinta (1º)

en.title: Watch Good Morning Amapá this Thursday (1st)
en.summary: G1 broadcasts three daily news programs: Good Morning Amapá at 7 AM, JAP1 at 11:45 AM, and JAP2 at 7:05 PM.

stories.title: Netanyahu diz ser cedo para apontar responsáveis por incidente com avião; Flydubai suspende voos para Israel

en.title: Netanyahu says it is too early to assign responsibility for plane incident; Flydubai suspends flights to Israel
en.summary: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu stated it remains premature to determine who was responsible for the Flydubai incident where a copilot stabbed the pilot during flight. The aircraft was diverted to Saudi Arabia and landed safely in Tabuk after losing control and descending over 4,000 meters in approximately 30 seconds.

stories.title: Jeans premium une inovação, durabilidade e sustentabilidade em nova linha da Renner

en.title: Premium jeans combines innovation, durability and sustainability in new Renner line
en.summary: Renner has launched a new premium jeans collection emphasizing innovation, durability and sustainable practices.

stories.title: Emirados Árabes abrem investigação sobre ataque em voo da FlyDubai que ia para Israel

en.title: United Arab Emirates opens investigation into attack on FlyDubai flight heading to Israel
en.summary: The United Arab Emirates prosecutor general announced an investigation into an incident aboard a FlyDubai flight to Israel. Authorities will determine whether the incident involving a copilot and commander could be linked to terrorist activity.

stories.title: Israel quer condecorar passageiros que evitaram acidente; Emirados Árabes anunciam investigação

en.title: Israel wants to decorate passengers who prevented accident; United Arab Emirates announce investigation
en.summary: Israel intends to award passengers involved in preventing an aviation accident while the United Arab Emirates have initiated an official investigation into the incident.

stories.title: What to Do in Rio in October 2026: Festival do Rio and Five Weeks of Bossa Nova

en.title: What to Do in Rio in October 2026: Festival do Rio and Five Weeks of Bossa Nova
en.summary: Rio's October 2026 cultural calendar features the Festival do Rio, five weeks of bossa nova performances in Leblon, Tom Zé at Circo Voador, and return of classic football matches.

stories.title: Saideiras do Rio Gastronomia, Festival do Rio, Toquinho, festival de bossa nova e rock no Circo: o que fazer no Rio

en.title: Rio Gastronomia finale, Festival do Rio, Toquinho, bossa nova festival and rock at Circo: what to do in Rio
en.summary: Rio's cultural programming features the final weekend of Rio Gastronomia with performances, Toquinho's show at Vivo Rio, and the Bossa Nova Sessions festival running through November in Leblon.

stories.title: Nota Fiscal de Serviços deve trazer informações da reforma tributária a partir deste mês

en.title: Electronic Service Invoice Must Include Tax Reform Information Starting This Month
en.summary: Service providers subject to ISS tax must begin issuing electronic invoices with information on new goods and services taxes (IBS/CBS) starting January 1st, 2026, as part of the tax reform implementation schedule.

en.title: Tax Reform of Public Services
en.summary: A report on tax reform measures affecting public services.

stories.title: Lula tenta conter abstenção, e Flávio Bolsonaro foca voto útil na reta final da campanha

en.title: Lula tries to contain abstention, and Flávio Bolsonaro focuses on tactical voting in the final stretch of the campaign
en.summary: In the final stretch of the first election round, President Lula seeks to mobilize elderly voters to reduce abstention, while Senator Flávio Bolsonaro plans to use a televised debate to attract undecided and right-wing voters.

stories.title: Combate ao crime organizado marca reta final da campanha no Brasil, diz imprensa francesa

en.title: Organized Crime Fight Marks Final Stretch of Brazil Campaign, French Press Says
en.summary: Major French newspapers report that organized crime combat is central to Brazil's election campaign with three days remaining, noting militia violence against left-wing candidates has shocked the public.

stories.title: Desemprego na zona do euro fica estável em 6,4% em agosto apesar de pressões econômicas

en.title: Eurozone Unemployment Remains Stable at 6.4% in August Despite Economic Pressures
en.summary: The eurozone unemployment rate stayed unchanged at 6.4% in August despite higher interest rates and an energy crisis triggered by Middle East conflict.

stories.title: Saque-aniversário do FGTS: veja o calendário de outubro de 2026

en.title: FGTS Birthday Withdrawal: See October 2026 Calendar
en.summary: Workers born in October who chose the birthday withdrawal option for their FGTS accounts can access funds starting October 1, 2026, with withdrawals available through December 30, 2026. Workers born in August and September have earlier deadlines for their respective withdrawals.

stories.title: Calendário do INSS para outubro de 2026: veja quando começa o pagamento

en.title: INSS Calendar for October 2026: See When Payment Begins
en.summary: INSS beneficiaries will begin receiving payments on October 26, 2026, with distributions continuing through November 9, 2026. Payment dates are determined by the last digit of the beneficiary number and the recipient's income level.

stories.title: Que horas é o debate da Globo? Veja horário e onde assistir

en.title: What Time Is the Globo Debate? See Schedule and Where to Watch
en.summary: Globo network will broadcast a presidential debate on October 1, 2026, three days before the first round of elections. The debate will air on TV Globo after the national news around 21:20 and will also be available on Globoplay, G1, and GloboNews.

stories.title: Bolsa Família de outubro de 2026 paga valor maior; veja calendário e tabela atualizada

en.title: Bolsa Família October 2026 Pays Higher Value; See Calendar and Updated Table
en.summary: Bolsa Família beneficiaries will receive October payments starting October 19, 2026, through October 30. The October payments will be the first to include a 15.04% adjustment, raising the minimum guaranteed value per family from 600 to 691 reais.
